summary: OpenCart is an e-commerce platform designed for setting up and managing online storefronts. It provides the core functionality needed to list products, process customer orders, and handle basic web shop operations.
goodFor: It is a suitable option if you want a dedicated PHP-based shop system that you can host on your own infrastructure.
watchOut: You will need to manage your own payment gateway integrations, security updates, and plugin compatibility as your catalogue grows.
deployNotes: You will typically need a standard PHP runtime environment paired with a relational database like MySQL or MariaDB, along with a web server such as Nginx or Apache.
